film.format: lyric-free visual narrative; optional sidecar SRT

thesis: Love is not the refusal of dust; it is the act of remembering, together, that turns dust into rain.
anti_thesis: A beautiful apocalypse with no human decision at its center.

emotional_curve.state: routine as a form of grief
a fall from the sky reopens hope
a quiet image that outlasts the song

visual_chapters.name: The Tally
visual_chapters.world: ash valley, glass dome, one green point
visual_chapters.space: wide, symmetrical, vertical dome ribs; tiny human
visual_chapters.grammar: stillness, negative space, one moving thing per shot

visual_chapters.name: The Guest
visual_chapters.world: the same dome, now inhabited; storm and sprout
visual_chapters.space: two-shots, over-the-shoulder, hands, breath on glass
visual_chapters.grammar: proximity, interruption, touch; the frame gets fuller as the seed grows

visual_chapters.name: The Storm
visual_chapters.world: the dome breaks; the tree answers; ash becomes rain
visual_chapters.space: wide verticals, shards, roots, bodies against weather
visual_chapters.grammar: weather as antagonist; shape rhymes (seed/eye/drop/tree); the frame opens

visual_chapters.name: The Orchard
visual_chapters.world: a green valley, a grounded ark, ordinary life
visual_chapters.space: wide, open, horizon; the tree as a vertical axis
visual_chapters.camera: slow crane, static long takes, final close-up
visual_chapters.grammar: release; the camera stops pushing; the world keeps moving

sound_visual_map.visual: one green point in a vast ash field; almost no motion
small domestic sounds: dropper, tally, glass
the ark passes; the pod detaches; wind rises
recognition; the frame warms; the boy is laid among plants
quiet tending; two cranes; the ark signal blinks
the argument; hands and eyes; the seed between them
storm repair; physical effort; the pod opens
growth and joy; the tree answers; the countdown returns
the empty doorway; the launch; the wind
storm, return, tree, rain, reunion — the film's largest images
time-lapse green; ordinary happiness; one leaf
